events.info: Newly engaged Brad and Janet have a flat tire and are lost on a dark and stormy night. They walk to a nearby castle in hopes of using the phone, but discover that there's a party going on. They are welcomed by Riff Raff, Magenta, an Dr. Frankenfurter, and the fun begins. Enjoy elaborate costumes, dancing, monsters, UFO's, and amazing songs. The Rocky Horror Picture Show starring Susan Sarandon, Tim Curry, Barry Bostwick, Meatloaf, and narrated by Charles Gray is one of the enduring late night Cult Film Classics. This movie is rated R.

events.name: Glenn Miller Orchestra
events.info: The World-Famous Glenn Miller Orchestra will perform their greatest hits, including "In The Mood," "Chattanooga Choo Choo," "American Patrol," "A String Of Pearls," "Little Brown Jug," "Pennsylvania 6-5000," "Tuxedo Junction," and of course their theme song "Moonlight Serenade" as they continue their national tour. The 15 member orchestra, their lead singers, and vocal group will perform their catalog of big band classics just the way they would have over 80 years ago when Glenn Miller stood in front of his band. It is a show that continues to transport audiences back in time and is as nostalgic as it is exciting. Touring continuously since 1956, The Glenn Miller Orchestra is featured in over 200 concerts and dances per year. Each performance includes the timeless classics that made them famous the world over in a show that has moved audiences for generations.
